name: google-calendar
description: Manage Google Calendar events: list upcoming schedule, create events, check what's on a specific date.
skillSummary: Manage Google Calendar events. Create, update, reschedule, edit, or delete events. List upcoming schedule and check what's happening on specific dates. Also handles OAuth2 setup to connect the calendar.

tools.name: google-calendar.list-events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events. Can filter by date range.

date.description: Date to check (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Use 'tomorrow' or a specific date.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default 1). Use 7 for a week view.

startTime.description: Start time (HH:MM, 24h format). Omit for all-day event.

endTime.description: End time (HH:MM, 24h format). Defaults to 1 hour after start.

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses

tools.name: google-calendar.check-schedule
tools.description: Check if a specific time slot is free or busy.

tools.name: google-calendar.update-event
tools.description: Update an existing upcoming calendar event. Use this to reschedule, rename, or change the time of an event. Find the event by title.

eventTitle.description: Title (or partial title) of the event to find and update

newDate.description: New date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use 'tomorrow', 'today', or a specific date.

tools.name: google-calendar.delete-event
tools.description: Delete an upcoming calendar event by title. This permanently removes it from Google Calendar.

eventTitle.description: Title (or partial title) of the event to delete

tools.name: google-calendar.setup-oauth
tools.description: Start the OAuth2 setup flow to connect Google Calendar. Call this if Google Calendar is not yet authorized.

tools.name: google-calendar.exchange-code
tools.description: Exchange the OAuth2 authorization code to complete Google Calendar connection. Call this immediately when the user provides a Google authorization code (typically starts with '4/1' or '4/'). Do not ask for more info — just call this tool with the code.

code.description: The authorization code from Google (starts with '4/')
